userStories.title: Validate workflow terminal WebSocket origins
userStories.description: As an operator, I want incoming terminal WebSocket upgrade requests strictly validated against the allowed origin, so that cross-site websocket hijacking attacks are rejected before connection establishment.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/origin.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/origin.test.ts.
Define TerminalOriginError with status 403 and error message 'Forbidden origin'.
assertTerminalOrigin(request, env) rejects missing, malformed, opaque ('null'), file:, and non-http/https Origin headers by throwing TerminalOriginError.
When env.WEB_UI_ORIGIN is set to a concrete URL (not '*'), assertTerminalOrigin requires the request Origin to match its normalized .origin value exactly.
When env.WEB_UI_ORIGIN is unset or '*', assertTerminalOrigin compares the request Origin hostname against the request Host header hostname, permitting different ports to support the Vite dev proxy.
All unit tests pass via bun test src/routes/terminal/origin.test.ts in packages/server.

userStories.title: Isolate workflow terminal subprocess environments
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want terminal subprocesses to execute with strict environment variable allowlists, so that Archon server secrets, database credentials, API tokens, and SSH keys are never accessible to terminal users.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/env.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/env.test.ts.

buildHostTerminalEnv(source) copies only non-empty string values from HOST_ENV_KEYS: HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, LC_CTYPE, LC_MESSAGES, TZ, TMPDIR, USERPROFILE, HOMEDRIVE, HOMEPATH, PATHEXT, SYSTEMROOT, COMSPEC.
buildDockerClientEnv(source) copies HOST_ENV_KEYS plus DOCKER_HOST, DOCKER_CONTEXT, DOCKER_CONFIG, DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY, and DOCKER_CERT_PATH.
Both environment builders unconditionally overwrite TERM with 'xterm-256color' and COLORTERM with 'truecolor'.
Neither builder forwards SSH_AUTH_SOCK, DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, API tokens, or any unrecognized environment variables.

userStories.title: Resolve workflow terminal host and container targets
userStories.description: As a workflow developer, I want terminal targets resolved strictly from database rows without user override, so that terminals attach safely to real checkouts or running containers and fail clearly without host fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/docker.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/docker.test.ts.
buildDockerExecArgs(cwd, handle, shell) generates literal argv array: ['exec', '-i', '-t', '-e', 'TERM=xterm-256color', '-e', 'COLORTERM=truecolor', '-w', cwd, handle, shell].

inspectContainer(handle, runner) runs docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' with 5000ms timeout, returns 'running', 'stopped', or 'missing' (matching case-insensitive 'no such object' or 'no such container'), rethrowing any daemon error.
resolveContainerShell(handle, runner) tests /bin/bash executable via docker exec; if it fails non-zero and container is running, falls back to /bin/sh.

Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/target.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/target.test.ts defining TerminalTarget, TerminalUnavailableReason, TerminalRunRow, TerminalIsolationRow, ResolveTerminalTargetDeps, and resolveTerminalTarget.
resolveTerminalTarget requires non-empty run.working_path; if absent, returns unavailable reason 'no_checkout'.

When run.metadata.isolation_env_id is present, inspects isolation row; provider 'container' requires active status, prefers containerName over containerId, checks container running state, and returns container target or unavailable reason 'container_missing' or 'container_stopped'.
Provider 'worktree' continues through host directory resolution; providers 'vm', 'remote', or unknown return unavailable reason 'unsupported_provider'.
Any container-marked run with missing/destroyed isolation row or stopped container never falls back to host directory.
Host resolution calls canonicalDirectory(cwd) using realpath and stat.isDirectory(), returning host target with resolveHostShell() or unavailable reason 'no_checkout'.
All unit tests pass via bun test src/routes/terminal/docker.test.ts src/routes/terminal/target.test.ts in packages/server.

userStories.title: Validate workflow terminal WebSocket frames
userStories.description: As a server developer, I want strict framing, byte limits, and type guards for client and server control messages, so that malformed or forged payloads are rejected before processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/protocol.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/protocol.test.ts.

Export protocol constants: TERMINAL_PATH_RE, RECONNECT_MS (120000), REPLAY_MAX_BYTES (262144), INPUT_MAX_BYTES (65536), PENDING_MAX_BYTES (1048576), MAX_CLIENT_FRAME_BYTES (394240), MIN_COLS (1), MAX_COLS (500), MIN_ROWS (1), MAX_ROWS (200), DEFAULT_COLS (80), DEFAULT_ROWS (24), SOLO_TERMINAL_USER_ID ('solo'), REPLACED_SOCKET_CLOSE_CODE (4001).
Export types: ClientControlMessage (input, resize, close), ServerControlMessage (ready, exit, unavailable, error), ClientMessageParseResult.
isResumeToken(value) validates 64-character lowercase hex string (/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/).

parseClientControlMessage(raw) parses JSON text frame, strips unknown fields, enforces byte length <= INPUT_MAX_BYTES for input, enforces integer range bounds for resize, and returns { error } on malformed frames.
serializeServerControlMessage(message) serializes typed server control message to JSON string.

unavailableMessage(reason) maps TerminalUnavailableReason to locked copy: 'no_checkout' -> "This run's checkout isn't available — it may not be ready yet, or it may have been cleaned up.", 'container_missing' and 'container_stopped' -> "This run's container isn't available — it may have been stopped or cleaned up.", 'unsupported_provider' -> 'This run uses an isolation provider the terminal cannot open.'.
All unit tests pass via bun test src/routes/terminal/protocol.test.ts in packages/server.

userStories.title: Spawn interactive Bun terminals for workflow runs
userStories.description: As a systems developer, I want host shells and container exec sessions spawned using Bun inline terminal options, so that child processes have a true controlling terminal and support interactive signals.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/pty.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/pty.test.ts.
Export SpawnedTerminal interface (write, resize, kill, exited promise) and TerminalSpawnSpec.
buildTerminalSpawnSpec(target, sourceEnv) builds command, cwd, and env using buildHostTerminalEnv for host and buildDockerExecArgs + buildDockerClientEnv for container.
spawnTerminalPty(input) spawns process using Bun.spawn with inline terminal options: { cols, rows, name: 'xterm-256color', data(_terminal, bytes) { input.onData(bytes); } }.
spawnTerminalPty never creates a detached Bun.Terminal(); fails fast if subprocess.terminal is absent.
kill() is idempotent: terminates process with SIGTERM, closes terminal, and does not throw on repeated calls.
exited promise resolves to { code, signal } with signalCode normalized.
Include one POSIX integration test demonstrating real controlling terminal behavior where SIGINT (Ctrl-C, '\x03') interrupts a sleeping child command.
Modify root package.json engines.bun from '^1.3.0' to '^1.3.5'.
All tests pass via bun test src/routes/terminal/pty.test.ts in packages/server.

userStories.title: Manage reconnectable workflow terminal sessions
userStories.description: As an operator, I want terminal sessions owned in memory per user and run with bounded replay, active tab takeover, and backpressure handling, so that disconnects survive network blips while memory remains bounded.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/session-manager.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/session-manager.test.ts.
Export TerminalSocket, TerminalSessionManager interfaces and createTerminalSessionManager factory.
Key sessions by '${userId}:${runId}' and generate 64-character lowercase hex resume tokens using crypto randomBytes(32).
When a second active socket connects for an existing key, take over the session: clear pending output, attach replacement socket, replay bounded buffer suffix, and close old socket with code 4001.
Old socket close callback does not mutate or detach the replacement session.
When a socket disconnects, retain the session for RECONNECT_MS (120,000 ms); reattach only when valid matching resumeToken is supplied.
Invalid or missing resumeToken on a disconnected session destroys the old PTY and allows creating a fresh session.
Maintain in-memory replay buffer retaining at most the newest REPLAY_MAX_BYTES (256 KiB) of binary output; never persist to disk.
Handle Bun send() return values: -1 sets backpressure flag and queues subsequent chunks; 0 detaches socket; positive integer confirms bytes sent.
Enforce PENDING_MAX_BYTES (1 MiB) ceiling across socket buffered amount and pending queue; overflow sends error message, closes with code 1011, and destroys session.
drain(socket) flushes application queue in order until empty or send() returns -1.
Explicit closeSession, process exit, expiry timer, and destroyAll() kill the PTY idempotently and remove the map entry.

Lifecycle logging emits only terminal.session_started, terminal.session_reconnected, terminal.session_completed, terminal.session_failed, terminal.session_expired, terminal.pty_exited with safe metadata (no commands, paths, tokens, handles, or output).
All unit tests pass via bun test src/routes/terminal/session-manager.test.ts in packages/server.

userStories.title: Serve authenticated workflow terminal WebSockets
userStories.description: As a server architect, I want incoming WebSocket upgrades authenticated, routed to the terminal endpoint before Hono, and wired into Bun.serve lifecycle, so that users can connect securely.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/endpoint.ts and test file packages/server/src/routes/terminal/endpoint.test.ts.

Implement createTerminalEndpoint(deps) resolving identity: 1) Better Auth session, 2) ARCHON_WEB_AUTH_HEADER header, 3) SOLO_TERMINAL_USER_ID ('solo') if API gate is disabled; throws 401 if gate enabled and no auth.

handleUpgrade validates same-origin, requires GET and Upgrade: websocket headers (426 otherwise), decodes runId, looks up workflow run (404 if missing), validates resume query param, and calls server.upgrade with runId, userId, resumeToken.
WebSocket open callback attempts manager.attachExisting; if not attached, resolves target, sends locked unavailable control frame on unavailable targets, or spawns PTY and calls manager.create.
WebSocket message callback parses JSON control frame; dispatches input and resize to manager; destroys session on binary frames or malformed JSON.
WebSocket close and drain callbacks delegate to manager.disconnect and manager.drain.

Create packages/server/src/routes/terminal/server-fetch.test.ts proving exact terminal path intercepts before Hono and unrelated paths pass to app.fetch.
Modify packages/server/src/index.ts to wrap Bun.serve fetch with createFetchWithTerminal, register terminalEndpoint.websocket, and call terminalEndpoint.destroyAll() during shutdown.
